uplink._note: Upstream-example input (TTN milesight-iot ct103 codec yaml, Apache-2.0). expected.data via the ported Milesight TLV decoder (oracle). Measured current (A) -> power.current; per-channel min/max and alarm fields as camelCase extras. Satisfies power-meter.
Input `0498B80B` verbatim from the vendor payload table's example (uint16/100 A). Satisfies power-meter.

uplink.description: Total current channel (0x03/0x97): 100 Ah -> totalCurrent extra
uplink._note: Input `039710270000` verbatim from the vendor payload table's example. The channel is an accumulated ampere-hour counter (uint32/100 Ah), not energy, so it stays the `totalCurrent` extra rather than metering.energy.total (Wh).

uplink.description: Current sentinel 0xFFFF: no reading, currentSensorStatus extra only
uplink._note: Input `0498FFFF` verbatim from the vendor payload table's example. The sentinel carries no current value, so power.current is omitted rather than emitted as 655.35 A.

Authored input for the documented 0x09/0x67 channel (int16/10 C) — the optional NTC cable probe on the USB-C port. 23.5 C is inside the probe's -20..100 C measuring range (https://resource.milesight.com/milesight/iot/document/ct10x-datasheet-en.pdf). Emits the top-level vocabulary key `temperature`.
Authored input pinning the sign handling of the int16/10 temperature channel; -5.2 C is inside the probe's -20..100 C range.

uplink.description: Temperature sentinel 0xFFFD: no reading, temperatureSensorStatus extra only
uplink._note: Authored input for the documented temperature sentinels (0xFFFD over range, 0xFFFF read failed). No temperature value is emitted.

uplink.description: Temperature alarm channel (0x89/0x67): 45.0 C + threshold alarm
uplink._note: Authored input for the documented 0x89/0x67 channel (int16/10 C + 1-byte alarm; 0 = threshold alarm release, 1 = threshold alarm). The reading itself normalizes to `temperature`; the alarm travels as the `temperatureAlarm` extra.

uplink.description: Combined periodic uplink: total current + current + cable temperature
uplink._note: Authored multi-channel stream (the three documented telemetry channels concatenated) pinning TLV index advancement across channels of different lengths.
A zero-byte uplink decodes to nothing; the codec must report an error rather than a data object carrying only make/model.
Synthetic input with an unrecognized channel id (0x77); the ported decoder breaks out of its TLV loop and recognizes nothing, so our codec reports an error.

uplink.description: Unknown downlink-response type is reported, not thrown
uplink._note: The ported decoder throws on an unrecognized 0xFE/0xFF response type; the wrapper converts it to `errors` so no exception escapes decodeUplink into the network server.
